veranderings.voor: kleineer hom of maak hom bang, of laat hom ongewens voel
veranderings.na: kleineer hom, maak hom bang of laat hom ongewens voel
veranderings.rede: The four actions form one list, so commas separate them and only the last is joined by 'of'; the double 'of' and the comma before 'of' in a list are against AWS 2017.

vlae.teks: soos om hom te slaan, skop, brand of gooi
vlae.rede: 'om hom te gooi' without a complement reads unnaturally in Afrikaans (throw him where, or throw things at him?); fixing it needs the intended meaning, so it is flagged rather than changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Om dit verder te neem is die werk van grootmense soos
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'dit verder neem' is a calque of English 'take it further'; idiomatic Afrikaans would be e.g. 'die saak verder te voer' or 'verder daarmee te gaan', if the writer wishes to reconsider.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Dan kan hulle 'n maatskaplike werker of die polisie inbring
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'inbring' calques English 'bring in'; 'betrek' is the idiomatic Afrikaans verb here, while keeping 'kan'.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: As dit veilig is, mag jy 'Nee' sê en weggaan, ook vir 'n grootmens by die huis
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This sentence writes 'Nee' quoted and capitalised, while the protected sentence two lines later writes 'nee sê' in lower case; the two forms should probably match.
